(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix IP access control. Restricts access to a Coralogix team to a configured set of IP ranges. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/account-settings/ip-access-control/.
enable_coralogix_customer_support_access  tftypes.String computed
    description: The Coralogix customer support access setting.
id  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: The unique identifier for the company IP access settings. This is typically a company ID.
ip_access  nested SET computed
    description: The list of IP access entries.
ip_access.enabled  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Whether this IP access entry is enabled.
ip_access.ip_range  tftypes.String computed
    description: The IP range in CIDR notation.
ip_access.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The name of the IP access entry.
